controlled_provenance.control: Same executable and current Metal source; diagnostic-only toggle changes K32/specialization, Q4 half shadows, and dense Q8 unpack defaults together. Both arms retain the scratch-release code.
controlled_provenance.instrumentation_scope: Generic pipeline cache and Qwen specialized MV/MM cache misses; separate dense/attention specialized factories are not instrumented.

measurement_notes: All 26 outputs and requested expert-read counts match within the same prompt and generation limit.
Only the two identical controlled long series are pooled, four runs per arm; all historical series remain separate.
Whole-phase rates are printed to two decimals by the runtime; comparisons use harmonic means.
The second 50-forward window contains decode calls 49-98 for long prompts; the first includes two prefill calls.
Warm timing throughput is 1000 / mean summed stage, encode, gpu and read milliseconds; encode includes intermediate GPU/SSD waits, gpu is the final wait only.

SSD timing total and delta are cleanup-only whole-run counters, not phase snapshots; identical delta snapshots are deduplicated. Timing averages/totals are milliseconds, readahead_gib is GiB, and other counters are counts or average counts. Requested pread bytes are not physical SSD traffic.
The prefill rewrite toggle and pipeline instrumentation exist only in ignored diagnostic source copies, not production.
Filesystem cache, storage latency, background macOS work and clocks are not controlled; these samples do not guarantee a speedup or establish a universal decode bound.
